description: Standalone responsive inspector panel. Auto docks in-flow when its container resolves Desktop and composes a modal TmDrawer on narrower ones — the sheet position follows the VIEWPORT (right/left side sheet on a tablet or desktop viewport, bottom sheet on a mobile viewport); Docked and Sheet pin the choice at every width. For editors with a dedicated frame see TmEditorShell.

parameters.name: Presentation
parameters.description: How the panel presents itself: Auto docks when the container resolves Desktop and is a sheet otherwise; Docked and Sheet pin the choice.

parameters.name: Open
parameters.description: Whether the panel is open. Two-way with OpenChanged.

parameters.name: OpenChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the panel should open or close (every close path funnels through here).

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: Title shown in the panel header; also the accessible name of the sheet.

parameters.name: RestoreFocusTargetId
parameters.description: Id of the host element (typically the opener button) focus returns to when the SHEET presentation closes — via Escape, the header close, the backdrop, a swipe or the host setting Open to false. Null keeps the focus scope default.

parameters.name: HeaderActions
parameters.description: Optional actions rendered in the header, next to the close button.

parameters.name: FooterContent
parameters.description: Optional footer below the body (apply / cancel actions), sticky at the bottom of the docked panel and of the sheet.

parameters.name: Side
parameters.description: The edge the panel belongs to (Right inspector, Left navigation/task panel); decides the edge the side sheet slides in from.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: Width of the docked panel and of the side sheet. Ignored by the bottom sheet.

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: The layout the presentation resolves from. Auto follows the nearest unnamed layout context; a forced value renders that mode without a DOM.

parameters.name: InitialMode
parameters.description: The layout rendered before the first measurement.

parameters.name: ResolvedLayoutChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the resolved layout changes. The initial value is not a change.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Extra CSS classes for the root (the docked root, or the sheet root through TmDrawer.Class).
